_about: Every public URL of the old Jekyll site on the production host, and where it goes on this site (rebuild plan Part 6, Phase 5 step 19). Single source: the build reads it (src/lib/redirects.mjs) and scripts/check-redirects.mjs gates it.

Paths only, never a host (CLAUDE.md). 'from' is the path as the old site served it: percent-encoded where it had spaces, with '&' literal, exact case (GitHub Pages is case-sensitive). GitHub Pages also serves every .html path without its extension, and adds the trailing slash to a directory path, so one entry covers both forms.
'to' is a path on this site (optionally with #fragment), an absolute URL on an allowed external host, or null.

status 200: the same URL exists on the new site (a page, or a file kept at the same path). status 301: a redirect page is built at 'from'. status 410: retired; no page is built, so GitHub Pages answers with 404.html and a real 404 status.
'todo' marks an entry that is a stand-in until content is migrated or an owner decides. `npm run check:redirects -- --strict` fails while any remain; run it that way at cutover.

Sources: the live sitemap.xml (65 URLs, fetched 23 Oct 2026), every permalink in mco-website/_pages, the five jekyll-redirect-from pages (_site/redirects.json), jekyll-feed's /feed.xml, and links found in the org's other repos (docs/cutover-inbound-links.md).
